lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For forty days the Philistine champion stood in the valley, morning and evening, calling for a champion of Israel. His height was six cubits and his spear was like a weaver's beam.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The men of Israel stood in their lines. No one moved. The giant's voice rolled across the valley like thunder.

lines.speaker: goliath
lines.text: Send me a man! Let him come down and fight. If he falls, we serve you. If I fall, we serve your God.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David was in the camp, sent by his father to check on his brothers. He heard the giant's taunt and saw the fear on every Israelite face.

lines.speaker: david_young
lines.text: Who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Saul wanted to clothe the boy in his own armour. David had not worn it before. He took it off and chose instead the tools of his trade.

lines.speaker: david_young
lines.text: I have not tested these. Let me take them off and go to the giant.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He took his staff, chose five smooth stones from the brook, and held his sling. The valley fell silent.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: The battle belongs to the LORD. Deliver him into your hand.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David ran toward the enemy, reached for the sling, and let the stone fly. It struck the forehead and the giant fell face down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David drew the giant's own sword and cut off his head. The valley erupted. The boy had not swung a sword at all.

choices.label: Give the credit to the God of Israel ✝️
choices.note: He names the LORD before the people cheer.

choices.label: Let the crowd carry the story 🎉
choices.note: Fame is sweet, and the moment is his alone.
